calculation.description: Fade a three-day risk-normalized overreaction, increasing reversal exposure when asset intraday range expands and when observation-only VIX is high relative to its trailing 252-day history. VIX is conditioning data only and is never traded. Signal is computed using data available through the decision-date close.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.051644, ICIR 0.161115), 2023-2024 (0.015701, ICIR 0.046767), and 2025-2027 (0.035569, ICIR 0.107986). Five- and ten-day decay is weaker than daily. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
